description: Assistant quoted last quarter's unit rate for two days after a tariff change
affected_people: About 140 customers who asked about prices
immediate_action: Switched the answer source to the live tariff service and sent a correction to affected customers
root_cause: The assistant read a cached copy of the tariff page that was refreshed monthly
corrective_action: Moved to the live tariff service and added a check that blocks answers when the feed is stale
lessons: Cached content needs an expiry date as much as the model needs testing

description: A call summary stored a customer's card number that was read out during a payment
immediate_action: Deleted the note, checked the audit log for access and informed the data protection officer
root_cause: Recording was not paused during the payment step and no redaction rule existed
corrective_action: Pause recording during payment; added a redaction rule; reminded agents in the team briefing
lessons: Test the tool on the awkward moments in a call, not only on clean examples

description: Assistant told a customer on the priority services register that a disconnection could go ahead without any extra checks
immediate_action: Handed the case to a senior agent, confirmed no disconnection took place and reviewed similar chats from the previous 7 days
root_cause: Under investigation: the priority services flag may not have reached the assistant for this customer
